headline: Weather Improves Across Luzon as Neneng and Habagat Weaken
seoTitle: Weather Improves Across Luzon as Neneng & Habagat Weaken | FMB News
seoDescription: PAGASA reported improving weather across Luzon on August 20 as TD Neneng weakened east of Taiwan and La Mesa Dam remained below overflow status.
deck: PAGASA reported a gradual easing of monsoon conditions across Metro Manila and much of Luzon as Neneng weakened near Taiwan.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: PAGASA reported improving weather across Metro Manila, Central Luzon and CALABARZON on Thursday morning as Tropical Depression Neneng weakened near Taiwan and the Southwest Monsoon lost strength.
The approved FMB News brief also reported that La Mesa Dam remained below overflow level while floodwaters began receding in several previously inundated areas.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: Neneng had helped enhance monsoon flow over western Luzon during the preceding days. By early August 20, PAGASA was seeing a weakening moisture feed and a shift toward more localized showers rather than widespread heavy rain.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Improving weather gives local governments more room for road clearing, pumping operations and post-flood cleanup, but saturated ground and residual runoff can still create localized hazards.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Residents should continue following PAGASA and local disaster advisories for isolated thunderstorms, remaining floodwater and any changes in reservoir or river conditions.
